messages:
Sophie: quick capture from today's NorthBay call — they raised some product asks and a reliability pain that could affect renewal
Kevin: thanks, share the bullet list and i'll upsert to the backlog
Sophie: raw notes pasted below so cs/product can triage:
- ask: exportable per-team/per-route cost breakdown (finance wants line-items for QBR)
- ask: make response_format presets editable in console (they manage ~30 custom prompts)
- pain: webhooks showing long retry tails during traffic spikes; customers manually re-submit failed events
- ask: per-project embedding freshness TTL toggle instead of global setting
Maria: per-team billing is renewal-sensitive. if finance can't map spend to teams we lose visibility in contract negotiations
Diego: webhook retries — do we have traces showing queue growth or backpressure at time of failures?
Sophie: asked NorthBay for timestamps, they sent a tiny CSV excerpt: 
```
timestamp,route,status
2026-02-14T16:03:22Z,ingest-alpha,504
2026-02-14T16:03:23Z,ingest-alpha,timeout
2026-02-14T16:03:27Z,ingest-beta,200
```
Kevin: i'll check queue length and host metrics around those times, might be a bursting pattern. if product needs a severity score i vote webhook = P0 for CS
ProductBot: note: billing metering currently supports route tags; billing exports are monthly CSVs only. Feature request recorded as FR-7812
Diego: interim proposal: add an export endpoint that returns route/tag usage CSV for a given date range — low-risk stopgap
Maria: interim export acceptable for NorthBay (they need data for their finance team this week)
Kevin: proposed triage from CS: 1) webhook reliability (high renewal risk), 2) per-route metering export (billing visibility), 3) editable presets (DX), 4) TTL toggle (low)
Sophie: action items:
- Diego: upload logs + span traces, link here (ETA today EOD)
- Kevin: run spike correlation analysis (ETA tomorrow)
- Maria: collect sample finance export format and escalate with AM (ETA 2 days)
- Product: can a PM confirm feasibility/est effort for a CSV export endpoint?
ProductBot: created ticket: product-requests/FR-7812, backlog id PR-4678
Kevin: tagging @Product — customer is in mid-renewal, would appreciate a quick thumbs on scope
Diego: uploaded logs to shared drive: https://redwood-share/nb-logs/nb-2026-02-14.zip
Sophie: i'll draft a short renewal note summarizing risk and ask; will include these action items. thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria: will add a one-paragraph summary to the account doc once i have finance sample
Kevin: if product wants a live sync, i'm free 30m tomorrow morning; will coordinate calendar
Sophie: end
